I posted the draft bullets for June in #coastal-team, as a reply to your message. Nothing has gone to June.

The bullets cover four points:
- **Rename:** Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- **Saved report:** Moss's 18 May coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label makes the Mid-Atlantic cross-dock receiving supervisor search twice.
- **Handoff:** The label change is on the handoff list, and Bettina Kroll is covering the Pellow Home Living queue.
- **Shorthand:** "PHL" also turns up in port-logistics search results, so the two get mixed up.

I also noted ticket PD-4821, but it's a door-6 booking-view problem rather than the label.

The digest is from 18 May, so I couldn't tell whether the label has been fixed since. It's worth checking that before the note goes out.
